title: Messi vs Ronaldo's First Meeting: A Missed Penalty, 0-0
topic: Their first meeting was the 2008 Champions League semi-final, Barcelona v Manchester United: 0-0 at Camp Nou with a Ronaldo penalty missed, then United won 1-0 at Old Trafford (Scholes).
hook: The greatest rivalry ever started 0-0. With a missed penalty.
twist: No goals from either star in their first meeting; Ronaldo missed a penalty and United went through 1-0 on aggregate.
pinnedComment: Team Messi or team Ronaldo, and why? 👇
commentPrompt: Messi or Ronaldo: who won that first night? Pick a side.
loop: So... who really won their first meeting?
